test_cases.question: What type of committee assists the Commission under the GDPR?
test_cases.answer: The Commission shall be assisted by a committee. That committee shall be a committee within the meaning of Regulation (EU) No 182/2011, which is the EU regulation governing comitology (committee) procedures.
test_cases.supporting_quote: The Commission shall be assisted by a committee. That committee shall be a committee within the meaning of Regulation (EU) No 182/2011
key_phrases: within the meaning of Regulation (EU) No 182/2011

test_cases.question: When does the examination procedure under Article 93(2) apply?
test_cases.answer: Where reference is made to this paragraph, the examination procedure referred to in Article 5 of Regulation (EU) No 182/2011 shall apply. This procedure is triggered when other GDPR provisions explicitly reference Article 93(2) for adopting implementing acts.
test_cases.supporting_quote: Where reference is made to this paragraph, the examination procedure referred to in Article 5 of Regulation (EU) No 182/2011 shall apply
key_phrases: Where reference is made to this paragraph

test_cases.question: Does Article 93 deal with data protection supervision or administrative procedures?
test_cases.answer: Article 93 deals only with administrative and procedural matters concerning how the Commission is assisted by a committee for adopting implementing acts under the GDPR. It does not address data protection supervision, which is handled by supervisory authorities and the European Data Protection Board under other articles.
test_cases.supporting_quote: The Commission shall be assisted by a committee. That committee shall be a committee within the meaning of Regulation (EU) No 182/2011

coverage.93(1): Test cases 1 and 3 - Committee within meaning of Regulation 182/2011
coverage.93(2): Test case 2 - Examination procedure (Art 5 of Reg 182/2011) when referenced

b2b_relevance: LOW - Article 93 is purely procedural, establishing the comitology framework for implementing acts. B2B SaaS companies won't directly interact with this process. However, implementing acts adopted through this procedure (e.g., on adequacy decisions, standard contractual clauses) will affect your international data transfers and compliance obligations.
